name: rumindium-invoice
description: Sales-document generator for quotations, invoices, delivery orders and receipts.

scripts.dev: concurrently --names mail,api,web --prefix-colors magenta,blue,green "npm run dev:mail" "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @rumindium/api && npm run build --workspace @rumindium/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @rumindium/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @rumindium/web
scripts.db:migrate: npm run build --workspace @rumindium/api && npm run db:migrate --workspace @rumindium/api
scripts.db:migrate:generate: npm run build --workspace @rumindium/api && npm run db:migrate:generate --workspace @rumindium/api
